import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
pattern = re.compile(
    r"\b([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*(?:"
    r"(\d+)|"
    r"\(\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100"
    r")"
)

values = {}
for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, constant, source, increment = match.groups()
    if constant is not None:
        values[target] = int(constant)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
